## Services

### AI Agent & Automation Build

Turn a manual, repetitive workflow into an AI pipeline with a human in the loop.

- Intake from WhatsApp, email or forms
- LLM classification, extraction and OCR
- Review dashboard so people approve what matters
- Logs, alerts and a deployed, documented system

Proof: [UmrahFlow](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/umrahflow), [BPOAI](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/bpoai)

### AI Feature for Your Product

Add a reliable AI feature to an app you already run, without breaking what works.

- Chat, summarisation, transcription or vision
- OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq or Whisper
- Usage limits and cost controls
- Clean UI wired into your existing stack

Proof: [FreeNote](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/freenote-app), [Prove It Auto](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/prove-it-auto), [PureX](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/purex)

### Web or Mobile MVP

Go from idea to a real product people can sign up for, pay for and use.

- Next.js web app or React Native (Expo) mobile app
- Auth, payments (Stripe / RevenueCat) and admin
- Postgres, Supabase or MongoDB data model
- Deployed to production, handed over with docs

Proof: [Multi-Department POS](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/multi-department-pos), [Bible Trader](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/bible-trader), [VoltOutreach](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/voltoutreach)

## Featured case studies

### UmrahFlow — AI automation
**Context:** Freelance client | **Stack:** Next.js, Python / FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Claude Vision, Docker

**Problem:** Visa staff typed passport details by hand from photos pilgrims sent on WhatsApp.

**What was built:** A WhatsApp agent reads each passport (MRZ checked against Claude vision), staff approve it on a dashboard, and approved passports are staged for the Saudi Nusuk portal.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/umrahflow

---

### Multi-Department POS — Retail SaaS
**Context:** Freelance client | **Stack:** Next.js 16, Prisma 7, PostgreSQL

**Problem:** A cloth house records sales in each department but takes payment at one counter.

**What was built:** Department tills issue tickets, one checkout settles them as a single bill, and the owner sees stock, shifts and returns.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/multi-department-pos

---

### BPOAI — AI agents
**Context:** Lead developer at AIDEVGEN | **Stack:** Next.js 16, Supabase, Claude, Apify

**Problem:** A BPO directory had to stay current without a team updating it by hand.

**What was built:** Nine Claude-powered agents scrape new companies, score them, verify claims and run the email outreach.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/bpoai

---

### homeStructure — 3D design tool
**Context:** Personal project | **Stack:** Next.js 16, Three.js, react-konva, Zustand

**Problem:** Homeowners want to see a house on their actual plot before they pay an architect.

**What was built:** Enter the plot and the rooms you want, get a floor plan in seconds, walk around it in 3D and see a cost estimate. Everything runs in the browser.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/home-structure

---

### FreeNote — Mobile + AI
**Context:** Full-stack developer at AIDEVGEN | **Stack:** React Native, Expo, Firebase, Whisper

**Problem:** An hour-long lecture or meeting is hard to use if it only exists as audio.

**What was built:** A React Native app that transcribes with Whisper, then summarises and answers questions about each recording with Groq.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/freenote-app

## All projects

### Multi-Department POS — Multi-Tenant Retail SaaS
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer | **Company:** Freelance | **Stack:** Next.js, React 19, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Supabase

A multi-tenant, multi-department retail POS for a Pakistani cloth house: departments ring up sales as numbered tickets, a central counter takes payment, and the owner tracks inventory, KPIs, shifts, returns, and reconciliation. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma 7, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/multi-department-pos

---

### UmrahFlow — AI Automation Platform
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer | **Company:** Freelance | **Stack:** Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Claude AI, Docker

End-to-end Umrah/Hajj visa-automation platform: WhatsApp intake, AI passport OCR (MRZ + Claude vision), a human-review dashboard, and a bridge that stages approved passports for submission to the Saudi Nusuk portal. Built with Next.js, Python microservices, PostgreSQL, and Docker.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/umrahflow

---

### PureX — Mobile App & AI
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer | **Company:** AIDEVGEN | **Stack:** React Native, Expo, Supabase, Gemini AI, RevenueCat

A mobile app that scans product barcodes for nutrition and safety insights and surfaces location-based water-quality reports. Uses Google Gemini AI for analysis and a Supabase backend. Built with React Native, Expo, Supabase, and RevenueCat for subscriptions.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/purex

---

### VoltOutreach — Recruitment & Outreach Platform
**Role:** Lead Developer | **Company:** AIDEVGEN | **Stack:** Next.js, React 19, MongoDB, Anthropic AI, Cloudinary

A recruitment and outreach portal with job listings, candidate applications, an admin dashboard, and AI-assisted outreach. Includes Calendly booking and Cloudinary media handling. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, MongoDB, and the Anthropic AI SDK.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/voltoutreach

### homeStructure — 3D Architecture & Design Tool
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer | **Company:** Personal Project | **Stack:** Next.js, React 19, Three.js, react-konva, Zustand

A web app to design a climate-smart house on a real irregular plot. Draw and edit a 2D floor plan on the exact boundary, watch it build in live 3D, browse pre-built models, and get ventilation advice tuned to the local climate. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Three.js, and react-konva.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/home-structure

---

### HookFeed — AI Social Content Generator
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer (Collaborator) | **Company:** AIDEVGEN | **Stack:** Next.js, React 19, Fabric.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

A live SaaS that turns a topic into a ready-to-post social media design. Creators pick a post type (carousel, quote or meme) and a style, and the AI writes the hook and designs the visual in about a minute. Credit-based subscription plans. Built as Clay Imaginary with Next.js, React 19 and Fabric.js.

Case study: https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/clay-imaginary
